name: illustrator-quiz-board-multiline
exporter: Adobe Illustrator 2024 (28.6) - Export As > SVG, Styling: Internal CSS
story: A full-frame studio quiz board: the designer typed the question as one text object with a hard return in it, so Illustrator wrote stacked <tspan> lines (same x, y stepping 0/62) inside a single <text id="Question">, with four answer pills below. I claim ONE question field, because the question is one semantic item and where its words break is NoaCG's decision, not the design app's (owner, 2026-09-01; docs/SVG_AUTHORING.md section 3). The runtime re-wraps it into the room the card was drawn with, at the size it was drawn at. A field per line was what the owner actually got on 2026-09-01, and typing into one of those boxes left the rest of the old question on air.
idioms: Generator comment naming the SVG Export Plug-In build
root attrs in Illustrator's order with x="0px" y="0px", viewBox/width/height and xml:space="preserve" on tab-indented continuation lines
<style type="text/css"> as a direct child of <svg>, one property per .stN class, uppercase hex
multiline point type as one <text transform="matrix(...)"> holding tspans with x="0" and y="0"/"62" - the leading baked into y, no dy
tspans written with no whitespace between them so no stray text nodes appear between lines
_x20_ escapes with data-name holding the original spelling on every answer row and on the card group
<rect y="0" ...> with the zero x omitted on the full-frame backplate
tab indentation, one tab per nesting level
whyThisMatters: Stacked tspans and kerned-run tspans are byte-identical apart from whether y varies, so an importer that gets this rule wrong fails one of the two files every time - and the two failures are opposite: three unusable question boxes here, or a headline cut into its kerned fragments there. It is the quiz board the 2026-09-12 production has to ship, and the operator has to be able to replace the whole question in one write.
